Combining skilled carpentry with practical construction expertise to create spaces that feel like part of your home. blocks.html: Why choose timber when you could use traditional masonry construction? Well, timber framing offers an efficient, flexible approach to creating additional living space. It also provides a strong structural foundation and gives you plenty of freedom with the finished design. Plus, it can also help you create a warm, energy-conscious extension that works beautifully with modern living.
You can benefit from:

items: Bespoke layouts that suit your lifestyle
A finish designed around your existing property

blocks.html: A Lightweight Approach To Extending

Timber offers an excellent strength-to-weight ratio. Making it a practical choice for many extension projects. And the lighter structure can reduce demands on your existing building and foundations. So your project can therefore follow a more efficient construction approach where suitable.

What’s more, you also gain greater flexibility when planning your new space. Timber framing works well with different layouts, roof designs, doors, windows and external finishes. This helps you create an extension that works for your home rather than forcing your home around a standard design.
Efficient Construction With Design Flexibility

Want to add space without making your home feel like a building site forever? Timber framing can support an efficient construction process. Helping your project progress towards a finished room. Plus, you can also choose from a wide range of external finishes. This means your extension can complement brickwork, render, timber cladding or other existing materials.

chapters.heading: Timber Framed Extensions Built For Modern Homes

blocks.html: Your extension should do more than add square footage. It should make everyday life easier, more comfortable and more enjoyable. Which is why we build timber framed extensions with modern living in mind. Considering how you use your home, where natural light enters, and how each space connects.
From open-plan kitchens to dedicated family rooms, we create practical spaces that earn their place in your home.
Creating Comfortable, Energy-Conscious Spaces

A well-designed extension should feel comfortable throughout the year. Timber framing works naturally alongside modern insulation systems. This allows you to build a well-insulated structure that supports a comfortable indoor environment.
Furthermore, good insulation can also help your home retain warmth during colder months. And during warmer weather, thoughtful design can help keep your new space comfortable.

Designing Around Your Home’s Character
Does your home have features you want to protect? Perhaps you own a period property with plenty of character. Well, a new extension should enhance those features rather than compete with them.

We take your existing property into account when planning the construction. Considering proportions, materials, rooflines, openings and the relationship between old and new spaces. Ensuring the result feels considered and purposeful. While also giving you the modern space you actually need.

So, what actually happens when you choose our timber framed extensions? The process creates a structural timber framework before the project develops into your finished living space. Giving your extension a clear structural system from the beginning. It also allows the different construction elements to work together effectively.
From Structural Frame To Finished Room

Your timber frame forms the main structural skeleton of the extension. So we construct the frame to support the walls and roof while creating the shape of your new space. From there, the project develops through several important stages:

items: Prepare the extension area and establish the required foundations.
Construct the timber frame to create the structural shell.
Install insulation within the wall, roof and floor construction.
Fit windows and doors to create a secure, weather-resistant structure.
Complete external finishes to suit your property’s design.
Install internal finishes and services to create your finished room.

blocks.html: Ultimately, every project has its own requirements. So we tailor the construction process accordingly.
Integrating Insulation, Windows And Finishes

A great timber framed extension needs more than a strong frame. But we also need to bring each element together to create a comfortable, durable and attractive result. This helps your extension feel complete rather than simply added onto the back of your property.

chapters.heading: Where Do Timber Framed Extensions Work Best?

blocks.html: Could your unused garden space become a spacious kitchen? Perhaps your existing living room needs more breathing room. Timber framing can suit many different extension projects and property styles. And we can help you explore practical options based on your home’s layout, available space and goals.
Rear Extensions And Open-Plan Living Spaces

Rear extensions remain a popular way to transform how you use your home. Creating space for larger kitchens, dining areas, family rooms and open-plan living. And a timber framed structure can provide the flexibility needed to create these modern layouts. So you could connect your kitchen and garden more naturally with larger windows or glazed doors. Or you could also create a brighter family space with carefully positioned openings.
Bespoke Designs For Different Property Types
Every property presents different opportunities and challenges. A modern home may suit clean lines and contemporary finishes. Whereas a traditional property might need a more sympathetic approach.
